summary: Allocates and appends a 12-byte collision linked-list node (data pointer at +0, next pointer at +4, flag byte at +8) to a global list. Calls sub_53CFE0 first as a duplicate/lookup guard and returns its result; only when it returns zero and the data pointer a1 is non-null does it allocate via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12), initialize the node, and append it, updating the head (dword_7CDDF0), iterator (dword_7CDDF8), tail (dword_7CDDF4) and incrementing the counter dword_7CDDFC.

operations.description: v1 = sub_53CFE0(&a1, a1, 67585) looks up an existing entry and returns non-zero when a duplicate exists, preventing a second allocation.
If v1 (the lookup result) is zero, proceed with node allocation; otherwise return v1 unchanged.
If the data pointer a1 is non-null, allocate a new node; the empty-parameter case is skipped entirely.
v3 = OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12) allocates a 12-byte collision node.
Initialize the node: node[0] = a1 (data pointer), node[4] = 0 (next pointer), node[8] = 0 (flag byte); v3 is 0 when the allocation fails.
If the list head dword_7CDDF0 is non-null, append the node to the tail by writing v3 into (dword_7CDDF4 + 4).
Otherwise this is the first node: set head dword_7CDDF0 = v3 and iterator dword_7CDDF8 = v3.
Update the tail pointer dword_7CDDF4 = v3 and increment the node counter dword_7CDDFC.
Return v1 (the sub_53CFE0 lookup result), which is zero when a node was appended and non-zero when a duplicate was found.
